name: logo
summary: Renders a product monitor-type LOGO by name — the brand/technology marks from the product logo library (Assets → Logos). Two forms via `variant`: COLOUR (full-colour, default) and LINE (monochrome, inherits text colour); either falls back to the other, then to `no-icon`. The logo counterpart of obs-icon: use a LOGO for a technology/vendor/monitor-type; an ICON for a UI affordance. Names are case/space-insensitive + alias-friendly (docker→dockercontainer, aws→aws-cloud). ARCHITECTURE: a small BUILT-IN common set (~29) ships in the main elements bundle so obs-logo works standalone; the FULL library (250 colour + 195 line) loads from the separate OPT-IN `observeops-logos` bundle (one `<script>`), which the showcase site loads so every name renders. AI tools: the complete 445-name list is in this registry `names` — pick any of them; never invent a name.

name.note: the monitor-type / logo key — case- and space-insensitive; aliases resolve (docker→dockercontainer, aws→aws-cloud, vmware→vmware-esxi). Unknown → `no-icon`. Covers ALL four library sources: monitor-type (colour+line), Brand & Platform, and Software / Integrations (some brand/software marks are PNG — obs-logo renders them as an ).

variant.note: color = full-colour brand mark; line = the monochrome line-icon version (inherits the surrounding text colour). Falls back to colour then no-icon if a line version is not bundled.

size.note: px (a number/plain digits) or any CSS length.

label.note: accessible name (role=img + aria-label). Empty → decorative (aria-hidden), e.g. a logo beside its own text label.

decisionFlow: A technology / vendor / monitor-type mark that carries BRAND COLOUR (Linux, Docker, AWS, MySQL)? -> obs-logo.
A monochrome UI affordance that should inherit the text colour (chevron, search, trash)? -> obs-icon, NOT obs-logo.
The logo sits next to its own visible text (a menu row label)? -> leave `label` empty (decorative).
The logo is the ONLY label for an action/row? -> set `label` for a11y.
Need EVERY logo available (not just the built-in ~29)? -> load the opt-in observeops-logos bundle once; then any of the 445 `names` renders.

os.dontUse: a monochrome OS glyph is needed (use obs-icon)
os.example: the Log tree Router/Linux/Windows type nodes

cloud.dontUse: a generic 'cloud' UI icon (use obs-icon cloud)

database.example: a MySQL instance in a monitor list

fallback.useWhen: the type is unknown or not bundled — obs-logo shows `no-icon` so layout never breaks
fallback.dontUse: relying on it for a common type (add it to CURATED)
fallback.example: an unrecognised monitor type → the neutral placeholder

do: Use obs-logo for technology / vendor / monitor-type marks (they carry brand colour).
Names are case/space-insensitive — obs-logo name="Windows" and name="windows" both work; aliases resolve.
Leave `label` empty when the logo sits beside its own text; set it when the logo stands alone.
Compose it in lists/trees (obs-side-menu tree, monitor lists) via a `logo` field / <obs-logo>.
To render EVERY logo (not just the ~29 built-in), load the opt-in bundle once: <script src="…/@mtdt/observeops-ds-elements/dist/observeops-logos.js"></script>. The showcase site already does.
AI: choose the logo name from this registry `names` (all 445) — never invent one; unknown names fall back to no-icon.
dont: Don't use obs-logo for monochrome UI affordances — that's obs-icon.
Don't hardcode a logo /
Don't assume every one of the 242 is bundled — the curated ~114 covers common types; the rest fall back to no-icon.
Don't recolour a brand logo (they're intentionally full-colour).

a11y.summary: Decorative by default (aria-hidden) so a logo beside its own text label isn't announced twice. Set `label` when the logo is the only label — it becomes role=img with an aria-label. The SVG marks have no interactive semantics.

knownIssues.issue: COVERAGE is complete via the OPT-IN bundle: the main elements bundle carries only a small BUILT-IN common set (~29 colour/line) to stay lean; loading `observeops-logos.js` (in @mtdt/observeops-ds-elements/dist) makes ALL 250 colour + 195 line available (it sets globalThis.__OBS_LOGOS__; obs-logo prefers it and re-renders when it loads). Without that bundle, a non-built-in name shows the `no-icon` fallback. The full 445-NAME manifest is in this registry `names` (colour/line/aliases) for AI discoverability — names only, no SVG data.

changelog: 2026-08-11 — Crisp + aspect-correct logos (owner): the build now prefers the SVG source over a same-named PNG (motadata_full had both — the raster was pixelating when scaled up; the vector is crisp at any size). obs-logo now sizes by HEIGHT and derives WIDTH from the logo aspect (viewBox), so wide wordmarks (motadata_full) render wide instead of squished, while square marks stay square.

changelog.change: Coverage fix: included the Brand & Platform (images/logo) and Software / Integrations (images/software-logos) categories that were missing — motadata, servicenow, jira, microsoft-teams, slack, sebi. obs-logo now also renders raster (PNG data-URI) marks as an . All FOUR library sources are now covered (colour 247 unique + line 195).

Coverage completed via an OPT-IN split: the main bundle keeps a small built-in common set (~29); the FULL 250 colour + 195 line ship in a separate observeops-logos bundle (globalThis registry, loaded by the site + opt-in consumers) — obs-logo prefers it and upgrades on load. The complete 445-name manifest is exposed in the registry `names` for AI (names only). Same single source library (build-logos.mjs).

Added the `variant="line"` form — the monochrome line-icon version (from monitor-type-line-icons, currentColor), alongside colour. build-logos.mjs now bundles the curated common set in BOTH colour (~114) and line (~77); the full 250 colour + 195 line remain on the Assets → Logos gallery.

Added obs-logo — the logo counterpart of obs-icon: renders a product monitor-type LOGO by name from a curated ~114-logo bundle (generated by build-logos.mjs from the monitor-type-icons library), with case/space-insensitive names + aliases and a `no-icon` fallback. Composed by obs-side-menu (tree type nodes). Pairs with the Assets → Logos gallery.
